name: Webroot API Patterns
description: Webroot Unity API fundamentals through Conduit: the five X-Webroot-* headers and the console-user password grant behind them, the GSM key bound to the connection, the 25 read-only tools and which four Conduit admin-gates, the three paging styles (PageNr/TotalAvailable, PageNr/MoreAvailable, ContinuationToken), siteId vs. site keycode, date-range defaults, error statuses, and response size limits.
